title: Lehmer's totient problem with fewer than sixteen prime factors

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
Reproducibility source archive for Deep Bhattacharjee's research revision v1.5.0 of Lehmer's totient problem with fewer than sixteen prime factors. The full conjecture remains open. Numerical theorem statements are unchanged. The revision adds written elementary one-candidate reductions, a verification appendix, complete portable Lucas primality certificates for all 41 stored k=14 factors, and an aomart screen manuscript without margin line numbers.

Fresh program-C k=15 runs treated all 33,865,004 admissible p13 values per sign across the exact 55,443-task frontier. The verification account distinguishes fresh executions from archived checks, prior CI and searches not rerun. Exhaustive searches and the full conjecture are not Lean-formalised. Proof-attempt notes state the unresolved all-prefix exclusion.

The manuscript version DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.23617604. Its current source is submission/v1.5.0/manuscript/main.tex. The original preprint is Hexagon 2610.00454v1; a replacement identifier is pending. The current author is Deep Bhattacharjee. The earlier three-creator archive is credited explicitly. AI use is disclosed in the paper.
